_about: Public-domain William Cunningham (1805-1861, Free Church of Scotland, principal of New College, Edinburgh) for the Word Hoard: the posthumous works edited by James Buchanan and James Bannerman (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1862-63): The Reformers and the Theology of the Reformation, Historical Theology (2 vols), Discussions on Church Principles; and his Theological Lectures (London: Nisbet, 1878), raw Internet Archive OCR from Princeton and Toronto scans. CCEL and Gutenberg hold none of it. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 6 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
